secondary.defect: The account-ui English bundle (line 188) has the same switch to MessageFormat/choice syntax for error-invalid-multivalued-size, which i18next cannot render.

secondary.defect: The account-ui messages_en.properties line 188 has the same MessageFormat/choice change, which i18next cannot render.
